status: Frozen specification before experiments; no measurements exist

general.fixture_execution_gate: Actual material/fastener/load-path review, captive magnet insertion, guard, static load proof and loaded gap inspection must precede powered measurements. CAD/beam screen alone does not clear this gate.

C01_field.comparison: Signed CAD-Z normal field; source model field-Y component
C01_field.note: Remanence band is an input allocation requiring a material certificate or independent calibration. Unknown grade/Br prevents a quantitative model-validation pass.

C01_force.note: Compare the complete specified loop, including modeled return force. Full ACR1 phase force coefficient is not the coupon coefficient.
C01_force.residual_expanded_uncertainty: U_residual =sqrt(U_force^2 +(Kloop*U_current)^2), adding covariance or conservative terms when correlated; compare residual with U_residual.

C02_custody.scope: Single-cell slow horizontal bench; vertical indexing, launch restraints and hardware fault reliability are not qualified.

C03_ground_release.egress_condition: payload_aft_minus_carrier_aft - U95_relative_position >=0.5245 m by6 s, with no keeper/pallet recontact detected
C03_ground_release.scope: Support-dependent planar counterpart; external brake is a bench device, not validation of ACR1 active LSM arrest. Actual 3m/s source-coupled test remains subsequent.
C03_ground_release.brake_guard_rule: Measured brake force interval including U95 must lie inside1.5..2N.
C03_ground_release.brake_force_measurement_scope: Total opposing X force on carrier, external brake plus support/guide drag; characterize both separately and combined.

decision.accept: All relevant geometry/input/readiness gates and uncertainty-guarded comparisons pass; report only the tested scope.
decision.rework: Band overlaps after uncertainty, zero/span drift, unbounded support force or incomplete input certificates: retain data as inconclusive, correct rig/metrology under a new recorded setup, then repeat the predefined comparison.
decision.stop: Any loss of custody, missing proof with launch enabled, keeper contact, guard/catcher failure, exceeded electrical/temperature/energy limit or residual outside band after calibration checks: inhibit motion/current, retain data and do not raise limits.
decision.revision_rule: Do not widen bands or replace the prediction after seeing validation data. A changed model/fixture gets a new issue and separate fit/validation data.
